notes.zh: 评注：只有开局随机选中「德萨努」结局（gray_goo_empire_set）时，开门事件 distar.10950 才发出隐藏的 graygoo.100，建立德萨努协和国并开通 L 星团。其后的敌对由玩家行为（进入工厂星系、交战、攻陷殖民地）决定，没有固定时间表。
notes.en: Commentary: only when the game-start roll chose the Dessanu outcome (gray_goo_empire_set) does opening the L-Gate (distar.10950) fire hidden graygoo.100, which sets up the Consonance. Everything afterwards depends on player behaviour (entering the factory system, battles, invading colonies); there is no fixed schedule (events/distant_stars_events_3.txt:1375-1378; events/gray_goo_events.txt:754-1121).
